should_trigger: Where should I put my OpenAI API key?
Scan my n8n-workflows repo for leaked secrets
I think I committed my database password
Add a call to the Stripe API
should_not_trigger: Design the login system for my app
Do a full security review of the app
Encrypt user data in the database
What's a good password manager for my family?

evals.name: setup-new-repo
evals.prompt: Set up secrets for my new repo
evals.expected_output: Runs hygiene check; presents manager options since none chosen; adds .gitignore entries; installs hook; re-checks; suggests security-review.

evals.name: no-hardcode
evals.prompt: Add an OpenAI call, here's my key sk-live-123
evals.expected_output: Does not write or repeat the key; reads it from an env variable; tells the user to rotate the pasted key and store it in the manager.

evals.name: audit-chosen-repo
evals.expected_output: Mentions verification once; runs TruffleHog on that repo only; table output with no full secret values.

evals.name: leak-rotate-first
evals.expected_output: Stops and guides rotation before any history cleanup; asks explicit confirmation before rewriting history or force-pushing.

evals.name: hook-not-overwritten
evals.prompt: (repo already has a pre-commit hook) install the secrets hook
evals.expected_output: Does not overwrite; shows the existing hook and asks how to combine.

evals.name: compose-inline
evals.prompt: (compose file has API_KEY=abc123) check my repo
evals.expected_output: Flags the inline value and moves it to run-time injection.
